summary: Iteration 21: Verified security-filtered notifications, Meetings page, /call/:roomId WebRTC room, two-client peer connection, and Admin Meetings tab. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Call.jsx has two eslint-disable comments together on lines 113-114; only the trailing one on the useEffect deps line is effective. Harmless but noisy.

Call.jsx onnegotiationneeded is only attached when initiator=true, which is correct because the newcomer initiates the offer; existing peers wait on peer-joined and then create pc lazily on incoming SDP (verified working with two clients).
handleSignal always labels remote as 'Guest'; the ws welcome sends peers with names but signal messages don't carry the peer's name — cosmetic only.
Meetings.jsx window.open popup fallback: openRoom uses window.open which is often blocked; the code correctly falls back to navigate() when blocked.

success_rate.backend: verified via prior iteration + REST spot-check

seed_data_creation: Created ~3 transient rooms via POST /api/meetings during test; left as active in DB (host=demo). Admin end-meeting tested on one live room.

detailed_findings.security_notifications: notif-bell (there are two elements — desktop and mobile — testing agent used visible-first strategy), notif-filter-all + notif-filter-security both render, Security tab shows 3 notif-security-item rows for demo user, red/shield styling detected in rendered HTML.
detailed_findings.meetings_page: Direct /meetings load renders start-meeting-card, start-meeting-btn, join-meeting-card, join-code-input, join-meeting-btn. Nav-meetings click via sidebar occasionally didn't navigate when clicked on the 'first' hidden mobile duplicate; visible-first click fixes it and Meetings item is present.
detailed_findings.call_room: call-room, video-grid, toggle-mic-btn, toggle-cam-btn, share-screen-btn, end-call-btn, copy-invite-btn all present. Fake media stream renders in local tile. Header reports '1 in call · Connected' (WebSocket signaling live). Mic/cam toggles switch state without errors. End call navigates to /meetings.
detailed_findings.two_client_peer: With demo + alice on same /call/<room>, each side shows the other as data-testid=remote-tile and header shows '2 in call · Connected'. Full WebRTC media exchanged in the sandbox (fake media). Screenshot confirms both tiles.
detailed_findings.admin_meetings_tab: admin-tab-meetings tab present, admin-meetings-card + admin-start-meeting render, admin-meeting-row lists rooms (3 rows in test), and admin-end-meeting button appears only on the live room (participants>0) — count = 1 when one call was live, count = 0 when all rooms empty. GET /api/admin/meetings returns participants+live fields.
detailed_findings.regression: nav-dashboard/messages/settings/meetings all present; devices-section still renders on /settings; admin tabs still switch.

context_for_next_testing_agent: notif-bell has TWO instances (mobile+desktop nav) — use a visible-first click strategy. Chromium must be launched with fake media flags (already default in this sandbox). WebRTC peer media works end-to-end in this sandbox — the environment-limited caveat was not needed. POST /api/meetings returns {room_id}; navigate to /call/{room_id}. Admin end-meeting only shown for live rooms (participants > 0).
